correctness.rationale: Linn--Lawley's exact asymmetric cover-time formula is explicitly credited and can also be recovered by inclusion-exclusion over endpoint hitting times, each solving D phi''=r phi. Setting c=cosh(kappa/2), t=cosh(kappa(a-1/2)) reduces rM to F_c(t)=2c(2c^2-1)t/(t^2+c^2-1)-c/t-1. The derivative has sign P_c(t^2) with leading coefficient 3-4c^2<0 and positive constant (c^2-1)^2, yielding one positive zero and no interior local minimum. The edge-minus-midpoint difference is (c-1)(2c^2-c-2)/c; unique crossing c* gives complete argmin including three sites at equality. The local sign at t=1 is P_c(1)=5(c^2-1)^2-1, giving c_loc=sqrt(1+1/sqrt(5))<c*. Endpoint r=0 is a limit only.
